test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: O is the centre of this circle. Tangent drawn from a point P, touches the circle at Q. If PQ = 24 cm and OQ = 10 cm, then what is the value of OP?
solution:
Given:

O is the centre of this circle. Tangent drawn from a point P, touches the circle at Q.

PQ = 24 cm and OQ = 10 cm

Concept used:

1. If a tangent is drawn on a circle from an external point, then at the point of tangency, it is perpendicular to the radius.

2. In a right-angled triangle, Hypotenuse² = Base² + H
